Coram: Hon'Ble Ms Justice Moksha Khajuria Kazmi, Judge
 Order
By this petition, petitioner has alleged non-compliance of order dated 04.09.2024, operative para whereof is reproduced hereunder:

"In view of the stand of the Collector taken in the status report as well as the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner, this writ petition is disposed of with the direction to the indenting department i.e. respondent Nos. 1, 4, 5 and 6 to deposit the awarded amount in terms of final award along with statutory interest as per the J&K Land Acquisition Act, with the Collector Land Acquisition, Doda, within a period of six weeks' from the date a copy of this order is made available to the Collector, who upon receipt of the amount shall disburse the same to the interested landowners as per the acquittance roll, in accordance with law."

1 02.

sentences.text: Statement of facts stands filed by respondent No. 4, it is stated that in compliance to the directions of this Court, Assistant Commissioner Revenue (Collector Land Acquisition), Doda vide letter dated 14.10.2024 has requested the indenting department to deposit awarded amount for the construction of Bhalla Trown road at village Bhasti amounting to Rs. 94,84,190/-, to the office of the Collectorate, so that the same could be disbursed among the interested land owners, however, the Collectorate has received only an amount of Rs. 22,67,500/- from the indenting department through BEAMS, which has been duly deposited in the Treasury under Voucher No. 114/8443 dated 24.09.2025.

It is further stated that notice dated 25.09.2025 was also issued to the petitioners,
thereby directing them to attend the office of the Collectorate along with their requisite documents,
so that the land compensation could be released in their favour.

03. Learned counsel for the petitioners states that the petitioners had visited the office of the Collectorate and have already submitted the requisite documents, but dispute that till date no compensation has been released in their favour.

04. Ms. Chetna Manhas, Advocate is directed to deposit the amount received from the indenting department to the tune of Rs. 22,67,500/-, if not already received by the petitioners, before the Registrar Judicial of this Court within a period of three weeks.

05. Ms. Pallavi Sharma, Advocate appearing vice Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG for respondent Nos. 1 to 4 seeks and is granted last and final opportunity of three weeks for filing statement of facts/compliance, strictly in consonance with order passed by this Court dated 04.09.2024, failing which, Chief Engineer, PMGSY, Jammu is directed to appear in person along with record on the next date of hearing.
06.
